title: Dragon and Scroll Chart
description: A vibrant fantasy illustration shows a large black dragon covered in colorful percentage tags sitting on a horizontal alphabet chart spanning A to Z. To the left, a glowing scroll, an open book with a small white dragon, and scattered papers float against a cosmic night sky with a red moon, stars, and colorful nebulae.
prompt: Fantasy illustration of a large black dragon covered in colorful percentage stickers sitting across a long horizontal alphabet chart from A to Z with a gradient background. To the left floats a large glowing scroll with text, an open book with a small white dragon reading, and scattered papers. Dramatic cosmic night sky with a large red moon, stars, and colorful nebulae in the background.
